I went Basta Hiro for dinner with my friend. And honestly with the price and time i spent, this was not derserve. I order a salad, pasta and pizza. The Salad was good, but pizza was just too salty while the pasta was tasteless. 

And the most unaccepted things is my drinks - iced honey tea. It was completely sweet, and i ask for make it better tưice. But, the quality is the same.

Never come back :)
